methodology: Snapshot: 19 October 2026. 9,243 official presentation records reduce to 6,696 distinct normalized titles. The earlier public snapshot contributes 2,416 additional titles; the union contains 9,112 titles.

Repeated presentations are grouped by lowercased title with whitespace normalized. The strongest listed presentation label is retained (Oral, then Spotlight, then Poster). This is a public metadata collection, not a certified final acceptance list.

Current title and author metadata come from the official NeurIPS listing; abstracts and earlier-only records come from the linked public snapshot. Source status is shown per paper and can be filtered.
Topic labels use the displayed title-keyword rules. Tags overlap, and untagged papers remain searchable. Comparisons use the same union of public records in every cohort.
Session names are preserved where supplied. Dates are the date portions of source timestamps, not converted local conference schedules; consult the official page for exact times.
Institutions are deduplicated by exact supplied name. Name variants are not merged; missing affiliations are not inferred. Author counts group exact name strings and may combine namesakes.
